# Rules for the skinned draws' fixtures (FIX-P6a): a texture a blended VU draw
# samples is `clear` (alpha 0 on every texel, below every alpha test's
# reference), so under the alpha test the alpha plan (rd_alpha_plan.c) draws
# such a draw as its one failing pass: colour only, Z written by no pass.
# With the attachment read and GS state as shader data (the Turnip
# reporter's profile) that pass reads its attachment with Z writes off, the
# case whose skin-check twins go through the draw's own pipeline
# (rd_vu_skin_check.c twinDraw); the reporter's frame of issue 123 has two
# such draws (texture alphas wholly below the reference).  The other VU
# textures `opaque` (vu_opaque.rules.txt: one pass that writes Z), so both
# kinds of twin are drawn; the default rules otherwise.
glyphs     sheet
ramp       r8
date_split date
clear      vu abe
opaque     vu
alpha_ramp ate
bright     additive
gradient   abe
checker    sprite
grey       unused
checker
